Name: Bit-accurate FPGA fault injection (BAFFI) tool
Description: BAFFI supports fine-grain fault injection in AMD Ultrascale+ FPGAs. Supports permanent and transient fault models suitable for verification of ASIC (RTL) and FPGA designs. Automates robustness assessment of RISCV prototypes.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 4.3.04; IP card lives in the DAVOS repository (doc/BAFFI/IP_cards).
